dz: 艾萨克二世·安杰洛斯杀死了史蒂芬·哈吉奥克里斯多夫多利特人并随后向人民呼吁,导致了推翻安德洛尼科斯一世·科姆内诺斯并让艾萨克登上拜占庭帝国王位的叛乱.
de: Isaac II Angelos kills Stephen Hagiochristophorites and then appeals to the people, resulting in the revolt that deposes Andronikos I Komnenos and places Isaac on the throne of the Byzantine Empire.

dz: 艾萨克·安杰洛斯在安德罗尼科斯一世·科姆内诺斯(英语:Andronikos I Komnenos)的见证下被加冕为拜占庭皇帝,在人群拒绝艾萨克叔叔约翰·杜卡斯加冕后被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Isaac Angelos is crowned Byzantine emperor following the deposition of Andronikos I Komnenos and after the crowd rejects the coronation of Isaac's uncle John Doukas.
